row:
I teach a Massage & Bodywork Licensing Exam Review Course. #mblex I love to support graduates of massage school in passing this 'challenging' test.

Each week you can watch a shorter version of the recorded classes here, for free. I recommend you SUBSCRIBE. 
If this style of teaching works for you, attend and participate in live class when you join the Patreon community. https://www.patreon.com/jodischoles
Donations gratefully accepted via Venmo, @jodi-scholes

Our curriculum is based on the 7 categories you will be tested on for the MBLEx. We teach 44 lessons per year. 

About me: I am former Adjunct Faculty in the Allied Health/Massage Therapy program at Northern VA Community College. I am a Licensed Massage Therapist in 3 states and graduated in 1994. I have performed over 20,000 clients sessions. I am the author of the book, Body Blueprint - How Your Pain May Be Telling a Story. Available on Amazon. https://www.amazon.com/Body-Blueprint-Your-Telling-Story/dp/B0CS33ZBQV

emails.context: You'll receive more information shortly. Please add jodi@jodischoles.com to your safe list so you don't miss my messages.
